name: FiberRouter
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.97). Replaced keyword guess "input-validation".

descriptions.text: FiberRouter's swapAndCrossOneInch accepts a caller-controlled swapRouter (the target address used for the swap) together with caller-controlled _calldata, and forwards them as a low-level call without validating either the router or the payload. Because the FiberRouter contract held outstanding token approvals from its users, an attacker could pass USDC itself as the swapRouter and craft _calldata equal to transferFrom(victim, attacker, victim_balance), causing the router to execute an arbitrary transferFrom on the victim's behalf and drain any user who had approved FiberRouter. This is a classic arbitrary-call / missing input-validation bug.
